commands: align(member, nil, vars.member_engagement.distance, vars.member_engagement.duration, true) or postpone(vars.member_engagement.retry_delay)
comment: Stay near a living party member selected by name, job, role, or semantic marker. Empty targets disable positioning.
Choose the first eligible member in selector order; never select yourself. Standing closer is acceptable.
Only positions the player; does not engage, change battle targets, or force facing. Avoid competing movement imports.
